Interface NoiseGeneratorConfig

All Superinterfaces:
ChunkGeneratorConfig, DataPackSerializable, DefaultedRegistryValue<NoiseGeneratorConfig>
@CatalogedBy(NoiseGeneratorConfigs.class) public interface NoiseGeneratorConfig extends ChunkGeneratorConfig, DefaultedRegistryValue<NoiseGeneratorConfig>, DataPackSerializable
Noise generator config used in configurable chunk generators.
